prs.location:
Griffith Wood’s location on the longest tree-lined avenue in the Northern Hemisphere is as suited for commuting to and from the city centre as it is for enjoying relaxed suburban living. 

Griffith Wood is located on the prestigious Griffith Avenue, Dublin 9. While quiet and peaceful, the community is a vibrant one that’s well populated by local shops, schools, parks and recreational sporting facilities. All of which are just minutes away and can be reached on foot. 

The complex is also close to Dublin City Centre, Dublin City University, Fairview Park, Croke Park, the International Financial Services Centre (IFSC) and East Point Business Park, and is well serviced by bus and cycle routes. The DART line in Clontarf is a short walk away, while Dublin City Airport and the M1 and M50 motorways can be easily accessed, allowing you to explore Dublin, the counties of Ireland and further afield.

description:
Our bright and spacious two-bedroom apartment is designed around your lifestyle. Fully equipped with home appliances that populate the fitted kitchen, every aspect of the apartment is geared towards your comfort, enjoyment and well-being. Ranging between 815 – 1,097 sq. ft, this two-bedroom apartment is designed and furnished for modern living.

But the Griffith Wood experience doesn’t start and end at your front door. As a resident, you’ll enjoy a range of benefits to help you achieve your ideal work-life balance, including:

 Concierge
 Residents Gym
 Residents Lounge
 Private Dining Areas
 Residents Events
 Co-Working Space
 Meeting Rooms
 On-site Maintenance
 On-site Management Team
 Car Parking
 Secure Bicycle Storage

Griffith Wood apartments are meticulously designed and furnished for modern living. Homes are spacious and bright, with high ceilings and large windows that increase natural light. Each room is furnished to the highest specification, including home office furniture as standard. From the large double bed, ensuite and fitted wardrobe in your bedroom to the bespoke sofa and armchair in your living room, utility room and additional storage room, to the home appliances that populate the fitted kitchen, every aspect of the apartment is geared towards your comfort, enjoyment and well-being.  

Griffith Wood is an accessible, pet-friendly development, with an on-site playground and parkland setting.

This is evident in where your apartment is located too: on a main bus and bicycle route, and within walking distance of a DART station, as well as the area’s wonderful array of local shops, cafés, restaurants and schools. Dublin City Centre, Dublin City University, the International Financial Services Centre (IFSC) and East Point Business Park are all within easy reach by car and public transport, and Dublin City Airport is less than 15 minutes away by taxi. 

Please note that all images, floorplans and included are for illustrative and indicative purposes only. Individual features and layout may vary. Prospective tenants must satisfy themselves by inspection or otherwise as to the correctness of the property.

Contact Number: 01-539 5581
